videos.script: Google's family is Gemini, and this lesson reads it from the sheet, because Google's pages were out of reach. {{lineup}} Three tiers: Flash-Lite, Flash and Pro. Every one has the same window, a million tokens. The versions do not line up, and the latest names are aliases. {{tiers}} One model, four prices. Standard, batch, flex and priority. And one more rule: once a prompt passes two hundred thousand tokens, the whole request costs more. {{modalities}} It reads images, audio and video. It can search the web while it answers, at a price per search. {{access}} Last, where it is sold. Google twice, at one price. Resellers, at the same price. And a batch route at half.
